correctness.rationale: The upper bound from the published threshold c=11/2 gives dim≤floor(13L/2). For all L, an explicit split isotropic Witt chart with p(0)≠0, three arbitrary Y-jets and residual W-jets has pairwise Gram products identically zero; odd L restricts two residual constants. The dual pairings recover every independent parameter, giving an algebraic injection of dimension floor(13L/2). Checks of exact rational identities L=1..15 corroborate but do not replace unrestricted proof.
